title: Tian Shan Glaciers Melt 4× Faster Than Global Average
description: The Tian Shan’s glaciers are receding at a shocking rate—almost four times faster than the world’s average. Scientists warn that by 2050 half of the remaining ice could vanish, threatening water supplies downstream.
narration: TIAN SHAN IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You imagine the Tian Shan’s icy caps are just another remote mountain range, melting at the same pace as the world’s glaciers. In reality, its ice is vanishing almost four times faster than the global average, reshaping the landscape dramatically. Since 1961 the Tian Shan glaciers have shed 27 percent of their mass – about 5.4 billion tons of ice. That loss rate is roughly four times the 7 percent loss measured worldwide. Climate models now predict that by 2050 only half of the range’s remaining ice will still exist. The accelerated melt also threatens downstream water supplies for millions of people who depend on its rivers. The Tian Shan’s ice is disappearing faster than ever— a silent alarm for the planet and the impact is already being felt.
